title: canvasArtifact
responsibility: Merges one canvas’s pages and links into a planning artifact without dropping others.

inputs.name: canvasArtifact.canvas
inputs.description: Canvas name, or the canvas data to show or record.

inputs.name: canvasArtifact.source
inputs.description: Repository address, commit, branch and optional viewer.

inputs.name: canvasArtifact.existing
inputs.description: The stage’s current artifact, whose other content is kept.

outputs.name: canvasArtifact
outputs.description: Result: Merges one canvas’s pages and links into a planning artifact without dropping others.
